## 🏛️ Architecture Decision Records (ADRs)

ADRs live at [`spec/00-adrs/`](./00-adrs/00-overview.md) and capture every
load-bearing scope/architecture decision that constrains the rest of `spec/`.
They are deliberately listed **outside** the auto-TOC because the directory
prefix `00-` reserves it as the architectural anchor for the whole spec tree.

> **Golden Rule:** any spec page that says *"MUST first amend via ADR"* is
> only enforceable because this directory exists. Removing or renaming an
> ADR file is itself a breaking change.

**When to consult ADRs first** (before editing any spec section):

1. You're about to add a new endpoint family, DDL table, or column.
2. You're about to relax a strict-TS / SQLite naming / WP-plugin folder rule.
3. You're about to introduce a second backend runtime, a new language, or a
   managed-cloud dependency.
4. A spec page footer says **"see ADR-NNNN"** — read that ADR first; do not
   amend the page in conflict with it.

To **propose** a change to a ratified rule, copy
[`spec/00-adrs/_TEMPLATE.md`](./00-adrs/_TEMPLATE.md) to the next free
`NNNN-kebab-case-title.md` and follow the lifecycle in
[`spec/00-adrs/00-overview.md`](./00-adrs/00-overview.md).

## Purpose

This file is the **canonical entrypoint** to the entire `spec/` tree. Every AI agent or human starting work on this project should read this file first, then drill into the specific domain folder they need.

> 🔴 **MANDATORY — AI Agents Must Read This Before Touching Any Spec or Code**
>
> 1. Read this overview.
> 2. Read [`folder-structure-root.md`](./folder-structure-root.md) for the canonical folder layout.
> 3. Read the `00-overview.md` of the specific domain folder you need.
> 4. Apply the **Golden Rules** below to every change you make.
>
> If a requirement is ambiguous or conflicts with a rule, **ask a clarifying question** — never guess.

---

## Project Identity

- **Name:** WorkFlowy (always capitalize as `WorkFlowy`)
- **Type:** Single-page web application — outliner / hierarchical task manager
- **Frontend stack:** Vite 5.4 + React 19 + TypeScript 5.6 (strict) + Tailwind CSS v4 (per ADR-0003, ADR-0007, ADR-0012)
- **Backend stack:** WordPress plugin running PHP 8.1+ + SQLite via PDO + REST namespace `workflowy/v1` (per ADR-0002)
- **Forbidden stack:** Go, **standalone PHP outside the WP plugin**, Postgres, MySQL, Supabase, Lovable Cloud, sql.js, IndexedDB-as-primary, Cloudflare D1, standalone Node, Next.js, Vue, Svelte, Angular

---

## Golden Rules (Apply to Every Change)

| # | Rule | Source |
|---|------|--------|
| 1 | **Strict TypeScript** — zero `any`, max 3 params per function, 15-line logic limit | [`02-coding-guidelines/02-typescript/`](./02-coding-guidelines/02-typescript/00-overview.md) |
| 2 | **Pure positive guard clauses** — no nested `if`s, flatten with early returns | [`02-coding-guidelines/01-cross-language/04-code-style/`](./02-coding-guidelines/01-cross-language/04-code-style/00-overview.md) |
| 3 | **Boolean naming** — `is/has/can/should/was/will` prefix, positive only | [`02-coding-guidelines/01-cross-language/02-boolean-principles/`](./02-coding-guidelines/01-cross-language/02-boolean-principles/00-overview.md) |
| 4 | **DB tables singular + PascalCase**, PK = `{TableName}Id`, FK = exact PK name | [`04-database-conventions/`](./04-database-conventions/00-overview.md) |
| 5 | **Unified `Item` interface** for every node (id, parentId, content, itemType) | [`31-app/`](./31-app/00-overview.md) |
| 6 | **250-item limit** per visible view (performance budget) | [`31-app/`](./31-app/00-overview.md) |
| 7 | **Tailwind CSS v4 only** via `@tailwindcss/vite` in `src/index.css @theme` block | [`32-ui-design/`](./32-ui-design/00-overview.md) |
| 8 | **No Go, no standalone PHP, no Postgres, no Supabase** in any code path. PHP is allowed **only** inside the WordPress plugin per ADR-0002. | This file + ADR-0002 |
| 9 | **Spec hygiene runs clean** — `node scripts/spec-hygiene/00-run-all.mjs` must exit 0 | [`18-spec-issues/`](./18-spec-issues/00-overview.md) |
| 10 | **No `any`-typed values cross any boundary** — enforced by ESLint | [`02-coding-guidelines/02-typescript/11-eslint-enforcement.md`](./02-coding-guidelines/02-typescript/11-eslint-enforcement.md) |

## Entry-Point Cheat Sheet

| If you are working on… | Read first |
|------------------------|------------|
| **A new feature** | [`31-app/`](./31-app/00-overview.md) → [`32-ui-design/`](./32-ui-design/00-overview.md) → relevant feature folder |
| **Database / schema work** | [`04-database-conventions/`](./04-database-conventions/00-overview.md) → [`05-split-db-architecture/`](./05-split-db-architecture/00-overview.md) |
| **TypeScript / coding rules** | [`02-coding-guidelines/02-typescript/`](./02-coding-guidelines/02-typescript/00-overview.md) → [`02-coding-guidelines/02-typescript/11-eslint-enforcement.md`](./02-coding-guidelines/02-typescript/11-eslint-enforcement.md) |

## Quality Gates

Before any commit or PR, the following must pass:

```bash
node scripts/spec-hygiene/00-run-all.mjs   # Numbering ✅ Headers ✅ Links ✅
npm run lint                                # ESLint zero warnings
npm run build                               # TS strict, zero errors
```
